# Switch

## Summary
A binary toggle for a setting that applies immediately.

## Shape
Deliberately distinct from a checkbox: a switch means the change takes effect now, whereas a
checkbox means the value is submitted later. `@isEnabled` and `@onChange` are the whole
contract, with `@label` as a visually hidden screen-reader name. One detail is load-bearing:
the rendered checked state and the `aria-checked` derived from it follow `@isEnabled` alone,
even when `@onChange` drops the value — so the control can never disagree with the state its
owner holds.

## Usage
Rendered in its states by the freestyle usage page at `packages/boxel-ui/src/components/switch/usage.gts`.

```gts
import { Switch } from '@cardstack/boxel-ui/components';
```
